name: Decoupled Toolbox — Decoupled Router add-on
description: Makes Decoupled Router functionality compatible with Decoupled Toolbox.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox — Decoupled Router add-on is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox. It registers an event subscriber (AliasConditionPreprocessor) on the parent module's EVENT__CONDITION_PREPROCESS filter event so a collection request can filter by `path.alias`: the subscriber uses Decoupled Router's PathTranslator to resolve the requested alias to an entity and rewrites the query condition into an entity-id condition. Requires the contrib Decoupled Router module.
